title: 👔 Middlesex County MA Executive & Management Roles $75K-$400K+ - NewsBreak
text:
22 hours ago Middlesex County’s leadership job market is buzzing this season — from biotech to construction, there’s a mix of high‑impact roles for experienced managers ready to take the next step.
Vice President, Clinical Operations Employer: Alkeus Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
Location: Cambridge, MA
Salary: $300K–$320K + bonus + equity
Type: Full‑time
Lead global clinical trials for a breakthrough eye‑disease therapy. Ideal for biotech leaders with 12+ years in clinical research and a passion for rare diseases.
Executive Director, R&D Quality Assurance Employer: Moderna
Location: Cambridge, MA
Salary: $224K–$404K
Type: Full‑time
Shape Moderna’s global R&D quality strategy across all GxP domains. A senior‑level role for those who thrive in innovation and compliance leadership.
Senior Director, New Product Strategy & Planning Employer: Ipsen
Location: Cambridge, MA
Salary: $217K–$310K
Type: Full‑time
Guide early commercialization and portfolio strategy for new therapies in oncology and rare disease. Perfect for strategic thinkers with 7–10 years in pharma marketing or BD.
Vice President, Membrane Operations Employer: Kovalus Separation Solutions
Location: Wilmington, MA
Salary: $177K–$262K + bonus
Type: Full‑time
Oversee global manufacturing operations for a leader in industrial filtration. Strong fit for operations pros with 10+ years in large‑scale production.
Program Manager & Operations Lead Employer: STR
Location: Woburn, MA
Salary: $140K–$193K
Type: Full‑time
Coordinate complex software development programs for defense and sensor systems. Requires active security clearance and strong technical management skills.
Director, Customer Advocacy Employer: Dell Technologies
Location: Hopkinton, MA
Salary: $192K–$249K
Type: Full‑time
Lead Dell’s global customer experience insights team. Great for data‑driven leaders with deep NPS and customer‑centric strategy experience.
AI Solutions Technical Product Manager – ISVs Employer: Dell Technologies
Location: Hopkinton, MA
Salary: $156K–$202K
Type: Full‑time
Drive Dell’s AI partner ecosystem strategy. Ideal for product managers with AI/ML expertise and a knack for building enterprise partnerships.
Principal Acquisition Program Manager Employer: Applied Research Solutions
Location: Bedford, MA
Salary: $175K–$195K
Type: Full‑time
Lead Air Force acquisition programs at Hanscom AFB. Requires a master’s degree, 15 years’ experience, and active Top Secret clearance.
Engineering Project Manager Employer: The TJX Companies, Inc.
Location: Marlborough, MA
Salary: $104K–$136K
Type: Full‑time
Manage large‑scale logistics and material handling projects for TJX’s distribution centers. Great for engineers with AutoCAD and project leadership experience.
Construction Project Manager (Commercial Property) Employer: Duffy Properties
Location: Waltham, MA
Salary: $110K–$150K
Type: Full‑time
Oversee tenant fit‑outs and capital projects across a 1.5M sq. ft. portfolio. Ideal for construction pros with 5+ years in commercial project management.
Service Manager Employer: Milltown Plumbing
Location: Chelmsford, MA
Salary: $65K–$85K
Type: Full‑time
Lead a residential service team for a trusted local plumbing and HVAC company. Includes company vehicle, 401(k) match, and paid training.
If you’re ready to lead teams, shape strategy, or scale operations, Middlesex County has a role waiting for you. Apply soon—these leadership seats won’t stay open long!
